key: ADRIENN: \PN!
en: ADRIENN: \PN!
ja: アドリエンヌ: \PN!

key: And from that gym! Thank goodness!
en: And from that gym! Thank goodness!
ja: それも、あのジムから!よかった!

key: We've had no luck reaching anyone up in Calcenon.
en: We've had no luck reaching anyone up in Calcenon.
ja: カルセノンの誰にも連絡がつかなくて。

key: Even Victoria never got back to me after leaving.
en: Even Victoria never got back to me after leaving.
ja: ヴィクトリアも、出発してから一度も連絡がないの。

key: Is everything okay?
en: Is everything okay?
ja: 大丈夫だった?

key: I see...
en: I see...
ja: そう……

key: So it's just like Devon. And that was just a prototype?
en: So it's just like Devon. And that was just a prototype?
ja: それじゃあデボンと同じね。しかもあれはただの試作品だったんでしょう?

key: I'd say I can hardly believe it, but unfortunately, I can.
en: I'd say I can hardly believe it, but unfortunately, I can.
ja: 信じられないと言いたいところだけど、残念ながら信じられてしまうわ。

key: The others-- are they well?
en: The others-- are they well?
ja: 他のみんなは――無事なの?

key: Just Saphira, then.
en: Just Saphira, then.
ja: それじゃあ、サファイラだけなのね。

key: As expected from the highest ranking Leader and our Champion-to-be.
en: As expected from the highest ranking Leader and our Champion-to-be.
ja: さすが最上位のリーダーで、次のチャンピオン候補ね。

key: I cannot approve of going along with Meteor's game, but I know that my comments are far too little and far too late.
en: I cannot approve of going along with Meteor's game, but I know that my comments are far too little and far too late.
ja: メテオの茶番に付き合うなんて、わたしは認められない。でも、今さらこんなことを言っても遅すぎるのよね。

key: I'll make preparations to head there myself and see if I can do anything to help those affected.
en: I'll make preparations to head there myself and see if I can do anything to help those affected.
ja: わたし自身がそちらへ向かう準備をして、被害を受けた人たちに何かできないか見てくるわ。

key: But first, you will be needing advice for Saphira, won't you?
en: But first, you will be needing advice for Saphira, won't you?
ja: でもまずは、サファイラ攻略のアドバイスが必要でしょう?

key: Of course-- One second, please.
en: Of course-- One second, please.
ja: もちろん――少し待っていて。

key: That would have been Monty's Gym, wouldn't it...
en: That would have been Monty's Gym, wouldn't it...
ja: あそこはたしか、モンティのジムだったはずよね……

key: Yes, here it is.
en: Yes, here it is.
ja: ええ、あった。

key: The most threatening feature of the gym is its boost to Dragon Type attacks.
en: The most threatening feature of the gym is its boost to Dragon Type attacks.
ja: このジムでいちばん厄介なのは、ドラゴンタイプの技を強化する効果ね。

key: Because they, and other moves like Dragon Dance, double in power, Saphira is free to invest heavily in Speed.
en: Because they, and other moves like Dragon Dance, double in power, Saphira is free to invest heavily in Speed.
ja: ドラゴンタイプの技もりゅうのまいのような技も威力が倍になるから、サファイラはすばやさに全振りできるの。

key: These boosts are available to you as well, and if you can make use of them, battles in this gym may become one-sided for either party.
en: These boosts are available to you as well, and if you can make use of them, battles in this gym may become one-sided for either party.
ja: この効果はあなたにも適用されるから、うまく使いこなせれば、このジムでの戦いはどちらか一方に大きく傾くはずよ。

key: Alternatively, a bulky Fairy Type may force her to set up and open a window in which to punish her offensive.
en: Alternatively, a bulky Fairy Type may force her to set up and open a window in which to punish her offensive.
ja: あるいは、耐久のあるフェアリータイプを使えば、彼女に積み技を強要させて、攻めの隙をつくこともできるわ。

key: Not that I'm trying to advertise or anything...
en: Not that I'm trying to advertise or anything...
ja: 別に宣伝してるわけじゃないけど……

key: However, none of these will help when it comes to her ace, Dragonite.
en: However, none of these will help when it comes to her ace, Dragonite.
ja: でも、彼女のエース、カイリューが相手だと、そのどれも役に立たないわ。

key: It's Multiscale ability will negate its Dragon Type weaknesses regardless of its health,
en: It's Multiscale ability will negate its Dragon Type weaknesses regardless of its health,
ja: マルチスケイルの特性のおかげで、HPに関係なくドラゴンタイプの弱点が無効化されるし、

key: And the heat of this field will soften Ice Type attacks.
en: And the heat of this field will soften Ice Type attacks.
ja: このフィールドの熱で、こおりタイプの技の威力も抑えられてしまう。

key: Therefore, Rock Type is your only viable choice to hit Dragonite effectively.
en: Therefore, Rock Type is your only viable choice to hit Dragonite effectively.
ja: だから、カイリューに効果的に攻撃できるのは、いわタイプだけよ。

key: Try to save such an attacker for it to reduce its chances to sweep.
en: Try to save such an attacker for it to reduce its chances to sweep.
ja: そういう攻撃役は、カイリューが暴れる可能性を減らすために温存しておくといいわ。

key: If anyone can win this, it's you.
en: If anyone can win this, it's you.
ja: あなたになら、これを勝てるはずよ。

key: This is your final hurdle before properly claiming your championship title!
en: This is your final hurdle before properly claiming your championship title!
ja: チャンピオンの称号を正式に手にする前の、最後の壁ね!

key: I'll be off now, to see what difference I can make up there.
en: I'll be off now, to see what difference I can make up there.
ja: それじゃあわたしは、あちらで何ができるか見てくるわ。

key: Best of luck, Champion.
en: Best of luck, Champion.
ja: 幸運を、チャンピオン。

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: グランドホールでは、誰も応答しないみたいね……

key: \PN opened the chest...
en: \PN opened the chest...
ja: \PNは宝箱を開けた……

key: \PN received the Treasure Badge!
en: \PN received the Treasure Badge!
ja: \PNはトレジャーバッジを手に入れた!

key: And...
en: And...
ja: そして……

key: SAPHIRA: You did well to clear those theatrics.
en: SAPHIRA: You did well to clear those theatrics.
ja: サファイラ: あの茶番をよく切り抜けたわね。

key: But that's just a formality.
en: But that's just a formality.
ja: でも、あれはただの形式に過ぎない。

key: It's time to put an end to this ridiculous 'tournament'.
en: It's time to put an end to this ridiculous 'tournament'.
ja: このばかげた「トーナメント」に、そろそろ終止符を打つ時ね。

key: Convincing Terra to let me use my gym was just a way to make sure I had a favorable Field Effect and ensure my victory.
en: Convincing Terra to let me use my gym was just a way to make sure I had a favorable Field Effect and ensure my victory.
ja: テラを説得して自分のジムを使わせてもらったのは、有利なフィールド効果を確保して、確実に勝つためだった。

key: But in return, if, by some fluke, you win, you'll have your final badge.
en: But in return, if, by some fluke, you win, you'll have your final badge.
ja: でもその代わり、万が一まぐれであなたが勝てば、最後のバッジは手に入るわ。

key: I consider this a fair exchange.
en: I consider this a fair exchange.
ja: これは公平な取り引きだと思っている。

key: Of course, that's just a formality too,
en: Of course, that's just a formality too,
ja: もちろん、それもただの形式に過ぎないけれど、

key: Since losing is not an option for me.
en: Since losing is not an option for me.
ja: わたしにとって、負けるという選択肢はないから。

key: I'll take this tournament for myself!
en: I'll take this tournament for myself!
ja: このトーナメントは、わたしがいただくわ!

key: ...Really.
en: ...Really.
ja: ……そう

key: SAPHIRA: Losing is not an option...
en: SAPHIRA: Losing is not an option...
ja: サファイラ: 負けるという選択肢はない……

key: I have a family to look after--
en: I have a family to look after--
ja: わたしには、面倒を見るべき家族がいる――

key: It's been my responsibility ever since our parents--
en: It's been my responsibility ever since our parents--
ja: 両親がいなくなってからずっと、それはわたしの責任だった――

key: SAPHIRA: Actually, that's not right.
en: SAPHIRA: Actually, that's not right.
ja: サファイラ: いえ、それは違う。

key: Even an orphan should have had a different guardian.
en: Even an orphan should have had a different guardian.
ja: 孤児であっても、本来なら別の保護者がいるはずだった。

key: But I didn't.
en: But I didn't.
ja: でも、わたしにはいなかった。

key: I was forced to learn several things about the world:
en: I was forced to learn several things about the world:
ja: わたしは、この世界についていくつかのことを、否応なく学ばされた：

key: Everyone is corrupt.
en: Everyone is corrupt.
ja: 誰もが腐っている。

key: No one is on your side.
en: No one is on your side.
ja: 誰も味方になんてなってくれない。

key: No one is going to listen.
en: No one is going to listen.
ja: 誰も話を聞いてくれない。

key: And funny, isn't it, that all you do is sit there and listen.
en: And funny, isn't it, that all you do is sit there and listen.
ja: それなのに、おかしいでしょう。あなたはただそこに座って、話を聞くだけ。

key: You play God like some kind of doll with a power it has no right having.
en: You play God like some kind of doll with a power it has no right having.
ja: 持つ資格もない力を手にした人形みたいに、あなたは神様ごっこをしている。

key: And just watch it happen.
en: And just watch it happen.
ja: そしてただ、それが起きるのを眺めているだけ。

key: Do you think you can solve any problem just by being able to defeat whatever team of Pokémon gets thrown at you?
en: Do you think you can solve any problem just by being able to defeat whatever team of Pokémon gets thrown at you?
ja: どんなポケモンチームをぶつけられても倒せるからって、それだけであらゆる問題を解決できるとでも思ってるの?

key: If you could, something would be wrong.
en: If you could, something would be wrong.
ja: もしそれで解決できるなら、何かが間違ってる。

key: But maybe that's the case.
en: But maybe that's the case.
ja: でも、たぶんそのとおりなんでしょうね。

key: Everything's wrong.
en: Everything's wrong.
ja: すべてが間違ってる。

key: The doctor is dead.
en: The doctor is dead.
ja: あの医者は死んだ。

key: So you say.
en: So you say.
ja: そう言われている。

key: And just what the hell do you think that leaves me to do now?!
en: And just what the hell do you think that leaves me to do now?!
ja: それで、わたしに一体何をしろって言うのよ!?

key: Protect my sisters?
en: Protect my sisters?
ja: 妹たちを守れって?

key: Let's be honest-- I've just been using them.
en: Let's be honest-- I've just been using them.
ja: 正直に言うわ――わたしはただ、彼女たちを利用してきただけ。

key: They've been the only way I could even convince myself to move forward.
en: They've been the only way I could even convince myself to move forward.
ja: 彼女たちだけが、わたしが前に進んでいると自分に思い込ませる唯一の方法だった。

key: In the end, he was always my focus.
en: In the end, he was always my focus.
ja: 結局、わたしの意識はずっと彼に向いていた。

key: So should I be happy that the thing I've been chasing this whole time is gone?
en: So should I be happy that the thing I've been chasing this whole time is gone?
ja: それじゃあ、ずっと追いかけてきたものが消えて、喜ぶべきなの?

key: I didn't want him dead-- I wanted to kill him myself!
en: I didn't want him dead-- I wanted to kill him myself!
ja: 彼に死んでほしかったわけじゃない――わたし自身の手で殺したかったのよ!

key: I wanted to finally take back the control I lost so long ago!
en: I wanted to finally take back the control I lost so long ago!
ja: ずっと昔に失った支配権を、ようやく取り戻したかった!

key: So that maybe-- just maybe, I could possibly begin to convince myself that I have an inkling of power,
en: So that maybe-- just maybe, I could possibly begin to convince myself that I have an inkling of power,
ja: そうすれば、もしかしたら――ほんのわずかでも、自分に力があるんだと思い込めるかもしれないから、

key: Even if it's just enough to keep myself safe.
en: Even if it's just enough to keep myself safe.
ja: たとえそれが、自分の身を守れる程度の力でしかなくても。

key: Because I know that I don't.
en: Because I know that I don't.
ja: だって、自分には力なんてないって分かってるから。

key: I can't.
en: I can't.
ja: できない。

key: Lin having done that...
en: Lin having done that...
ja: リンがあれをやってのけたことが……

key: Just proves it.
en: Just proves it.
ja: それを証明しているだけ。

key: That we were in this tournament--
en: That we were in this tournament--
ja: わたしたちがこのトーナメントに参加していたこと――

key: In this city--
en: In this city--
ja: この街にいたこと――

key: That I did lose here--
en: That I did lose here--
ja: ここで、わたしが負けたこと――

key: In the end, I know I'm helpless.
en: In the end, I know I'm helpless.
ja: 結局、わたしは無力なんだって分かってる。

key: Just like back then.
en: Just like back then.
ja: あの時と同じように。

key: I couldn't stop him.
en: I couldn't stop him.
ja: わたしは彼を止められなかった。

key: No one believed me.
en: No one believed me.
ja: 誰もわたしを信じてくれなかった。

key: Not even he remembers it.
en: Not even he remembers it.
ja: 彼自身、それを覚えてすらいない。

key: He was in a stupor, or some kind of trance--
en: He was in a stupor, or some kind of trance--
ja: 彼は放心状態というか、一種のトランス状態にいて――

key: He just kept saying it over and over...
en: He just kept saying it over and over...
ja: ずっと同じ言葉を繰り返していた……

key: "Lizzy, Lizzy, Lizzy,"
en: "Lizzy, Lizzy, Lizzy,"
ja: 「リジー、リジー、リジー」

key: Back and forth, back and forth,
en: Back and forth, back and forth,
ja: 行ったり来たり、行ったり来たり、

key: Crying the entire time.
en: Crying the entire time.
ja: ずっと泣きながら。

key: Over and over,
en: Over and over,
ja: 何度も何度も、

key: For what seemed like forever.
en: For what seemed like forever.
ja: 永遠とも思えるくらいの間。

key: SAPHIRA: But there's nothing left for me to do about it now, even if I do get out of here.
en: SAPHIRA: But there's nothing left for me to do about it now, even if I do get out of here.
ja: サファイラ: でも、たとえここから出られたとしても、わたしにできることはもう何も残ってない。

key: Your badge and TM are in the chest below.
en: Your badge and TM are in the chest below.
ja: バッジとわざマシンは、下の宝箱の中にあるわ。

key: Terra, you're still listening, right?
en: Terra, you're still listening, right?
ja: テラ、まだ聞いてるんでしょう?

key: I'm ready.
en: I'm ready.
ja: 準備はできてる。

key: Just put me down already.
en: Just put me down already.
ja: もう、わたしを終わらせて。

key: It's time to sleep.
en: It's time to sleep.
ja: 眠る時間よ。

key: SAPHIRA: If you're ready, you know what to do.
en: SAPHIRA: If you're ready, you know what to do.
ja: サファイラ: 準備ができているなら、やることは分かっているはずよ。
